description: Multi-step progress bar for wizards / checkout / onboarding flows. Distinct from <slide-accept> (slide-to-confirm). Author writes a native <ol> of <li> steps inside the element; the component decorates each with circle + connector + status (complete | current | upcoming | error) and visually hidden status text. With data-clickable, completed steps become native buttons.

attributes.name: data-current
attributes.description: Active step: matched against data-step ids first, then as a 1-based index. Defaults to the first step.

attributes.name: data-clickable
attributes.description: Completed steps render their label inside a native <button> (keyboard and pointer) that navigates back. The current and upcoming steps are not activatable.

attributes.name: data-direction
attributes.description: vertical stacks the steps with a vertical connector (narrow screens, long labels, 5+ steps).

attributes.name: data-label-list
attributes.description: Accessible name set on the <ol> when it has no aria-label / aria-labelledby of its own.

attributes.name: data-label-step
attributes.description: Visually hidden position prefix read before each label; {n} and {total}. Empty string removes it.

attributes.name: data-label-complete
attributes.description: Visually hidden status text for completed steps.

attributes.name: data-label-current
attributes.description: Visually hidden status text for the current step (empty by default: aria-current="step" already conveys it).

attributes.name: data-label-upcoming
attributes.description: Visually hidden status text for upcoming steps.

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Visually hidden status text for errored steps.

events.name: progress-tracker:step
events.description: Bubbles when data-current changes after upgrade (source 'attr') or a completed step is activated in data-clickable mode (source 'click', one event only). Not fired on upgrade or when the current step is activated.

childAttributes.name: data-step
childAttributes.description: Stable step id (any string; defaults to the 1-based position). data-current matches it before trying an index, so numeric ids like "2024" are safe.

childAttributes.name: data-error
childAttributes.description: Marks this step as errored regardless of position.

childAttributes.name: data-status
childAttributes.description: Set by the component; style hook.

childAttributes.name: aria-current
childAttributes.description: Set by the component to "step" on the current step.

structure.description: Required native ordered list of steps (renders as a plain numbered list without JS).

cssProperties.name: --pt-color-complete
cssProperties.description: Fill / connector colour for completed steps (default --color-success).

cssProperties.name: --pt-color-current
cssProperties.description: Outline / ring colour for the active step (default --color-interactive).

cssProperties.name: --pt-color-upcoming
cssProperties.description: Outline / connector colour for upcoming steps (default --color-border).

cssProperties.name: --pt-color-error
cssProperties.description: Fill / connector colour for errored steps (default --color-error).

cssProperties.name: --pt-color-text-on-fill
cssProperties.description: Glyph colour on filled (complete / error) circles (default --color-text-on-interactive-auto).
